title: ODS Dataset Provenance
description: Unified provenance document identifying the source TRUD archive, inner XML publication manifest facts, tool build identity, and dataset release version for an ods dataset. The document is written incrementally: 'ods trud pull' records source TRUD and publication metadata, while 'ods make' records tool build information and dataset version. A published dataset's _provenance.json always carries the fields enforced by ods's publish checks (trud_release_name, trud_release_date, trud_release_file, trud_release_filesize_bytes, trud_release_sha256, trud_release_sha256_verified, tool_git_dirty, tool_git_sha, tool_version, and dataset_version), verified by ods's own checks as the authority; all other fields are optional.
$comment: Build-run facts such as runner machine identifiers, execution timestamps, job IDs, and build environment details are intentionally excluded from this document so rebuilds reproduce byte-identical datasets and identical manifest digests. Build-run facts belong in an external SLSA provenance attestation accompanying the release.

$schema.description: URI of the JSON Schema describing this provenance document format.

trud_release_name.description: Human-readable release name of the TRUD item from NHS England's TRUD API (e.g. 'Release 8.0.0'). Source metadata recorded by ods trud pull.

trud_release_date.description: The release date of the source archive on NHS TRUD in YYYY-MM-DD format. Extracted from TRUD release metadata; recorded by ods trud pull.

trud_release_file.description: Filename of the source archive ZIP file downloaded from NHS England TRUD (e.g. 'ods_data_20260828.zip'). Recorded by ods trud pull.

trud_release_filesize_bytes.description: Size in bytes of the source TRUD ZIP archive file, greater than zero. Measured and recorded by ods trud pull.

trud_release_sha256.description: Upper-case 64-character hexadecimal SHA-256 hash of the TRUD source archive ZIP file. Computed and recorded by ods trud pull.

trud_release_sha256_verified.description: Method used to verify the TRUD release archive SHA-256 hash: 'trud_api' if verified directly against NHS England's authenticated TRUD API, 'published_release' if verified against a previously published trusted release, or 'unverified' if the archive was provided locally without API verification. Recorded by ods trud pull.

publication_date.description: Publication date declared in the inner XML publication manifest extracted from the TRUD archive in YYYY-MM-DD format. Recorded by ods trud pull.

publication_seq_num.description: Sequential publication sequence number declared in the inner XML publication manifest. Recorded by ods trud pull.

publication_type.description: Type of publication declared in the inner XML publication manifest (e.g. 'Full' or 'Snapshot'). Recorded by ods trud pull.

publication_source.description: Publishing organization or source system declared in the inner XML publication manifest (e.g. 'NHS England'). Recorded by ods trud pull.

publication_schema_version.description: Schema version of the data files declared in the inner XML publication manifest. Recorded by ods trud pull.

publication_record_count.description: Total record count declared across tables in the inner XML publication manifest. Measured and recorded by ods trud pull.

tool_version.description: Semantic version string (SemVer) of the ods CLI tool that built this release. Recorded by ods make.

tool_git_sha.description: Lower-case 40-character hexadecimal Git commit SHA of the ods tool repository at build time. Recorded by ods make.

tool_git_dirty.description: Boolean flag indicating whether uncommitted working tree changes were present when the ods tool binary was compiled. Recorded by ods make.

dataset_version.description: Semantic version string (SemVer) of the published dataset release build (e.g. '0.1.0'). Recorded by ods make.
